name: Profit Margin & Markup Calculator
description: Calculate gross profit, profit margin percentage, markup percentage, selling price, and cost multiplier across pricing scenarios.
search_intent: Calculate profit margin vs markup percentage and determine retail selling price from cost.
calculation: Gross profit = sellingPrice − costAmount. Actual margin % = sellingPrice > 0 ? (grossProfit / sellingPrice) × 100 : 0. Actual markup % = costAmount > 0 ? (grossProfit / costAmount) × 100 : 0. Cost multiplier = costAmount > 0 ? sellingPrice / costAmount : 0. Price for target markup = costAmount × (1 + targetMarkupPercent / 100). Price for target margin = targetMarginPercent < 100 ? costAmount / (1 − targetMarginPercent / 100) : null.
limitations: Margin and markup model gross pricing; selling costs, merchant transaction fees, and indirect overhead are not subtracted from gross profit.
Margin cannot equal or exceed 100% unless cost is zero or negative.
Wholesale discounts and volume tiered pricing should be factored into the base cost.
